brief: The 5-step sleep ritual that fixed my insomnia.

slots.headline: Can't Fall Asleep?
slots.subtitle: Here is the simple nightly routine that actually fixed my insomnia.

slots.title: Kill the Blue Light
slots.body: Cut blue light 60 min before bed. Swap screens for a paperback or stretch. Your melatonin will thank you.

slots.title: Cool Down Your Room
slots.body: Drop your thermostat to 65–68°F. A cooler core temperature signals your brain that it is time to shut down.

slots.title: Set a Caffeine Curfew
slots.body: No coffee or pre-workout after 2 p.m. Caffeine has a half-life of 5–6 hours and hides in decaf too.

slots.title: Breathe to Unwind
slots.body: Do 4-7-8 breathing or a quick body scan. It downshifts your sympathetic drive in about two minutes flat.

slots.title: Keep the Same Wake Time
slots.body: Wake up at the same time every single day. Yes, even on Sunday. Anchoring your circadian rhythm makes falling asleep effortless.

slots.title: Sleep Through the Night
slots.body: I started sleeping through the night in under two weeks. Pick one step tonight and build from there. Sweet dreams.
